Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=redwood-inference/gpu-alloc | alert=CUDA_ALLOC_FAIL | instance=gpu-pool-eu-3 | region=eu-west-1 | severity=high | active=8 in last 5m. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-17988
Alice Nguyen: acked. I'm looking at pool metrics and checking kvcache evictions. tagging @Sasha (SRE) for kernel logs.
Sasha (SRE): on it, pulling dmesg and nvidia-smi. Initial thought: fragmentation + prefetch thrash.
Bob Patel: handoff if needed in 20m. If this is a hot loop from customer X traffic, consider temporary rate-limit on their route.
Jen - Support: Customer X contacted via support, reporting increased 500s on /generate. Logged to CUST-4123.
Alice Nguyen: logs:
```
[2026-03-15T12:01:22Z] cuda: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (error 2)
[2026-03-15T12:01:23Z] inference: shard=eu-3 id=pool-03 model=redwood-13b qkv_cache_mb=2300 evict_count=124
```
Sasha (SRE): nvidia-smi output shows memory stall on gpu02 (78% memory still allocated, but fragmentation), dmesg shows frequent GPU page faults. Running probe script now.
Incident Bot: Autoscaler attempted to spawn new instance but hit quota in eu-west-1. scale_event_id=SE-9981
Alice Nguyen: mitigation plan:
1) temporarily reroute low-priority requests to model-variant=redwood-13b-quant (lower mem)
2) preemptively evict kvcache on pool-03 with `curl -XPOST https://internal-api/evict?pool=pool-03`
3) trigger graceful restart of worker process on gpu02 if preemptive evict doesn't free enough
I'll execute step 1 & 2 now.
Bob Patel: If reroute fails, prepare fallback to hosted tier (higher cost) and notify product for customer-impact comms.
Alice Nguyen: executed prefetch eviction:
```
$ curl -XPOST https://internal-api/evict?pool=pool-03
{"status":"ok","evicted_mb":1240}
```
Sasha (SRE): eviction freed ~1.2GB but fragmentation remains. Planning graceful restart of worker on gpu02. Will coordinate with Alice.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty update: PD-17988 escalated to SRE lead after 10m unacknowledged by escalation policy.
Alice Nguyen: performing graceful restart on gpu02: `systemctl restart redwood-worker@gpu02` — rolling to avoid mass failover.
Sasha (SRE): post-restart kernel logs look cleaner, no new page faults for 90s. Memory usage stabilized.
Jen - Support: informed Customer X of temporary performance impact; they're OK with fallback for now. Ticket updated CUST-4123.
Bob Patel: confirming manual reroute metrics: tail latency reduced from 720ms -> 210ms on affected route.
Alice Nguyen: closing actions: file ticket to track autoscaler quota for eu-west-1 (OPS-665), add prefetch backoff tweak to runtime (RFC-987). Setting follow-up postmortem if we see recurrence.
Sasha (SRE): tagging @kernel-team to review long-term fragmentation mitigations.
Alice Nguyen: marking as resolved in PagerDuty and adding notes. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty incident PD-17988 resolved by Alice Nguyen at 2026-03-15T12:26:50Z
